description: We are a science-focused team interested in astronomy, astrophysics, and space exploration. Our goal is to explore the Planet X and SPHEREx challenge by building an interactive and visually engaging web project. We want to use real astronomical data and modern web technologies like HTML, CSS, and JavaScript to make complex space concepts easier to understand. We enjoy learning and creative discovery and welcome collaboration and new ideas
summary: SPHEREx Time Explorer is an independent student-developed project that enables users to explore and compare real infrared astronomical data from NASA’s SPHEREx mission. It provides FITS image visualization, scientific metadata inspection, pixel statistics, histograms, and preliminary difference mapping, helping users understand infrared observations and explore the scientific information hidden within astronomical images.
details:
Project Overview

SPHEREx Time Explorer is an independent student-developed astronomy project designed to explore and compare real infrared astronomical observations from NASA's SPHEREx mission.

The application allows users to load two astronomical FITS images and examine their differences through scientific data analysis tools.

2. Main Features

FITS Data Reader: Reads astronomical FITS files directly in the browser.

Side-by-Side Comparison: Displays two infrared images simultaneously.

Image Statistics: Calculates mean, median and standard deviation.

Histogram Analysis: Visualizes the distribution of pixel values.

Difference Map: Displays pixel-level differences when scientific compatibility checks pass.

Interactive Visualization: Supports zooming and moving across images.
